minerbot.screen.title: MinerBot
minerbot.screen.crosshair.none: Aimed at nothing — corners will use where you stand
minerbot.screen.no_crosshair: You were not looking at a block when the menu opened
minerbot.tunnel.on: Digging outside the region is on
minerbot.tunnel.off: Digging outside the region is off
minerbot.error.region_too_large: Region is too large: %s blocks, limit %s
minerbot.error.nothing_to_mine: Nothing to mine in the selection
minerbot.error.missing_materials: Not enough materials in the hotbar:
minerbot.build.cannot_clear: could not clear what was in the way
minerbot.place.in_the_way: could not step out of the block's way
minerbot.place.no_face: no reachable face to click against
minerbot.screen.mine.block.tip: Which block to mine. Leave it blank to mine everything inside the region.
minerbot.screen.mine.tool.tip: Which tool to hold. Leave it blank and the fastest tool in the hotbar is used for each block.
minerbot.screen.from_crosshair.tip: Use the block you were aiming at when this menu opened.
minerbot.screen.from_hand.tip: Use the item you are holding.
minerbot.screen.mine.tunnel.tip: Off: the bot only breaks blocks inside the region. On: it may also dig through blocks outside it to reach the ones inside.
minerbot.screen.mine.start.tip: Walk to every matching block in the region and mine it.
minerbot.screen.build.copy.tip: Take a snapshot of the selected structure. Air is left alone, so the ground and plants between the blocks are not touched.
minerbot.screen.build.direction.tip: Each copy is offset by the size of the selection along this direction, so copies line up end to end.
minerbot.screen.build.copies.tip: How many copies to build, 1 to %s.
minerbot.screen.build.start.tip: Build the copies using materials from your hotbar.
